# PRD: x

## 1. Search

`live`

### Purpose

Search returns ten results.

### Flow

Whoever searches types the term and gets the list.

### Rules

| When | The product guarantees |
|---|---|
| the term matches nothing | the list comes back empty with the term repeated, not an error |
| the ranking criterion | `a definir`, and the catalogue owner decides |

## 2. Ranking criteria

`open`

### Purpose

Decide the order results come out in.

### Flow

`open`, and the catalogue owner decides.

### Rules

| When | The product guarantees |
|---|---|
| the criterion is defined | `a definir` |
